Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

munch 0.0.4

New features

  • Markdown text can contain LaTeX equations, written as in R Markdown and Quarto: $...$ in the text, $$...$$ alone on its line in display style. They take the colour and size of the text around them. md_grob(), element_md(), geom_text_md() and geom_label_md() draw them, and as_paragraph_md() gives them to ‘flextable’ as equations. A dollar that does not open an equation stays a dollar (5$ and 10$), and \$ is always a dollar.
  • Markdown text can contain superscripts and subscripts, written as in R Markdown and Quarto: m^2^, H~2~O. They contain no space, unless it is escaped (^a\ b^); ~~text~~ is still a strikethrough.
  • Drawing equations needs the package ‘equatags’ and R >= 4.3. Without them, the LaTeX source of equations is written as text, with a warning.

Changes

These changes make the text look like Word, and move or resize existing texts slightly:

  • Words are measured with the kerning of their font, as ‘ragg’, ‘svglite’ and ‘ggiraph’ draw them: spaces after kerned words are no longer too wide, right-aligned lines end exactly at the right edge, and lines can hold slightly more words.
  • The height of a line is the line height of its font, the single line spacing of Word; a larger line spacing adds its space below the line. Lines almost touched each other with a line spacing of 1. The default line spacing is now 1, the default of ‘flextable’, instead of 1.2, also for the lineheight of geom_text_md() and geom_label_md(): texts are a bit more spaced than before.
  • Superscripts and subscripts are 65% of the font size, raised by 0.34 or lowered by 0.07 of the font size, as in Word with Arial or Liberation Sans. Subscripts were barely below the baseline.

Bug fixes

  • Equations created with flextable::as_equation() were dropped without a message by chunks_grob() and element_chunks(); they are now drawn.
  • as_paragraph_md() with an image (![alt](path)) gave a paragraph that flextable::mk_par() and flextable::compose() refused. Images now have a height of twice the font size, as in md_grob(); an image that can not be read is dropped with a warning.
  • element_md() ignored its argument face (#4). Markdown emphasis now adds to it, and default_text_props() has new arguments bold and italic.
  • With width and hjust > 0, the text of md_grob(), chunks_grob(), geom_text_md() and geom_label_md() was shifted to the right of its anchor, and out of the box of labels.

Dependencies

  • ‘gdtools’ >= 0.6.0 is required.
  • ‘equatags’ >= 0.4.0 is suggested, to draw equations.

munch 0.0.3

CRAN release: 2026-11-10

New features

  • element_md() and element_chunks() have a new argument width to set the maximum width of the text. Use it with ‘patchwork’ or with a fixed aspect ratio to get titles with the right height (see below).

Bug fixes

  • Titles, subtitles and captions made with element_md() or element_chunks() could have their first lines cut at the top of the plot: their height was computed for the width of the plot instead of the width of their column. It is now computed for the width they are drawn with. With ‘patchwork’ or a fixed aspect ratio, this width is not known in advance: set width in these cases.
  • A word wider than the available width no longer overflows: it starts on a new line and, if it is still too wide, it is split between characters (without hyphen). Images, superscripts and subscripts are never split.
  • Consecutive line breaks now give empty lines, and spaces written after a line break are kept.

Changes

  • Text is now arranged into lines by flextable::layout_lines(), so that rich text wraps the same way in ‘munch’ and in ‘flextable’.
  • SVG images are rendered at the size they are drawn, so that they stay sharp.

Performance

  • Lines are arranged faster.
  • An image used several times is decoded only once in a session.
  • The size of ‘png’, ‘jpeg’ and ‘gif’ images is read from their file header, without decoding them: about 15 times faster.

Dependencies

  • ‘munch’ now requires ‘flextable’ >= 0.10.4, ‘officer’ >= 0.7.8 and ‘gdtools’ >= 0.5.3.

munch 0.0.2

CRAN release: 2026-04-16

Bug fixes

  • element_md() and element_chunks() no longer ignore plot.tag.position and plot.tag.location (#1).
